title: Essere o avere? La scelta giusta
summary: Reflexives take essere with agreement; some verbs take both auxiliaries with a meaning shift

blocks.title: The rule in short
blocks.body: **Avere** for most transitive verbs (*ho mangiato, ho letto*). **Essere** for motion/change (*sono andato*) and for **every reflexive verb** (*mi sono alzato*) — and in that case the participle always agrees with the subject.

blocks.title: A reflexive, step by step
blocks.body: *Alzarsi* (to get up) in the passato prossimo: the reflexive *mi/ti/si* stays, essere is the auxiliary, and the participle agrees.

items.en: I got dressed in a hurry. (a woman)

blocks.prompt: Sofia, this morning: 'I woke up at 7.' Which is correct?
blocks.explain: Reflexive → essere + agreement: *mi sono svegliata*, because Sofia is a woman.

blocks.prompt: Which verb can take EITHER avere or essere, depending on meaning?
blocks.explain: *Finire il libro* (avere, transitive) vs *il film è finito* (essere, intransitive).

pairs.left: *Ho finito il libro.* — I finished the book (transitive, avere)
pairs.right: *Il film è finito.* — The movie ended (intransitive, essere)
pairs.note: Ask yourself: is there a direct object? If yes, it's often avere.

pairs.left: *Ho cambiato idea.* — I changed my mind (avere)
pairs.right: *Sono cambiato molto.* — I've changed a lot (essere)
pairs.note: Same verb, different meaning depending on the auxiliary.

blocks.explain: *Mi sono alzato alle otto* — reflexive, essere, -o agreement.

blocks.prompt: Listen and type what you hear.

blocks.scene: Marco tells Giulia about his morning, at the bar

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.en: I woke up really late this morning.

lines.speaker: Giulia
lines.target: Ah no! Ti sei alzato dopo le dieci?
lines.en: Oh no! Did you get up after ten?
lines.spotlight: ti sei alzato — reflexive with masculine agreement, since it's addressed to Marco.

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.target: Sì, e poi sono passato in libreria prima di aprire.
lines.en: Yes, and then I stopped by the bookshop before opening.

lines.speaker: Giulia
lines.target: Almeno ti sei divertito ieri sera, no?
lines.en: At least you had fun last night, right?

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.target: Sì, mi sono divertito un sacco!

blocks.prompt: Write 2-3 sentences about your morning yesterday, using at least one reflexive verb in the passato prossimo.
